measurement: One intentional button activation, one select choice, one complete text-entry operation or one explicit text-range selection counts as one action. Setup, assertions, screenshots and reloads are excluded. No timing or percentage improvement is reported. Comparison tests an unnecessary memo detour for the same connection-only goal; it does not rank a genuine memo-writing task below direct connection.
limitations: The source sentence is preselected in a fixed synthetic fixture; arbitrary original-text selection is not implemented.
This prototype connects saved memo text only. The design allowance for directly connecting unsaved memo text is outside this demonstration.
Storage, account continuity, remote failures, backup restoration and real Apple devices are outside this demonstration.

priorEvidence.classification: Initial 15 scenarios; one harness timing assertion read the DOM before the native dialog close handler completed. Original 7-second limit retained; corrected test waits for exact-date row removal.

Focused run reproduced two prototype defects: missing explicit memo return after connection and unrelated default period selection on contextual target entry. Check correction passed after the harness correction.
